briefTitle: Study to Assess Adverse Events and Pharmacokinetics in Adult Participants With Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Other Solid Tumors, Receiving Intravenous Infusion of Azirkitug Alone or in Combination(s) With Budigalimab, Bevacizumab, or Telisotuzumab Adizutecan

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: NSCLC - Advanced or metastatic progressed on standard of care (SOC) including chemotherapy and prior anti-PD-(L)1 antibody (separately or in combination). Actionable gene alterations are eligible if failed targeted therapeutic options.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Advanced or metastatic disease without specific stage numbering does not map directly to a stage_in list, and actionable gene alterations eligibility has complex conditional options.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: HSNCC - Advanced/metastatic progressed on platinum and PD-1/PD-LI in recurrent or metastatic setting. Micro Satellite Stable Colorectal Cancer (MSS-CRC) - Progressed on Oxaliplatin, Irinotecan, a fluoropyrimidine, anti-EGFR, VEGF or VEGFR therapies, BRAFV600E or HER2, other targetable mutations targeted with locally approved therapy, TAS-102, Regorafenib and not MSI-h or MMR-deficient Gastric and Gastroesophageal Junction adenocarcinoma (GEA) - Advanced/metastatic progressed on at least 1 prior cytotoxic chemotherapeutic regimen and if applicable immune checkpoint inhibitor and/or HER2 therapy High-Grade Serous Ovarian Cancer (HGSOC) - Progressed serous epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer post SOC and not eligible for surgical resection. Platinum resistant cannot have >5 lines of prior therapy. Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (PDAC) - Advanced/metastatic progressed after SOC. Includes adenosquamous carcinoma and post-Whipple. Triple Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) - Progressed after 1 or 2 systemic therapy that must have included taxane and treatment naïve to immunotherapy targeting T-cell co-stimulation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: These criteria pertain to non-NSCLC cohorts included in the multi-tumor basket study.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC) - Excludes neuroendocrine or acinar pancreatic carcinoma and participants with coagulopathy or at risk of or history of Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)/PE
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Cohort-specific exclusion for pancreatic cancer.
